item.title: Marxist indoctrination
item.description:
Source: TW

Why do conservative parents have children who turn leftist? I will narrate my own childhood experience.

I studied 6th to 9th standard in a free government aided school started by a DMK affiliated person. I did not hear any DMK messaging there.

Then 10th to 12th, I moved to a free school funded by an RSS affilated person and had an RSS man as trustee. I did not even know what the RSS was and heard nothing about the RSS as a student.
